title: Senior Data Engineer @ING Hubs RO
full_description:
Discover ING Hubs Romania
ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of 𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝟐𝟎𝟎𝟎 𝐡𝐢𝐠𝐡-𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐬, 𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐤, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐟𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥𝐬.
We started out in 2015 as ING’s software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and 𝐨𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐭𝐰𝐨 𝐥𝐨𝐜𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬: 𝐁𝐮𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐂𝐥𝐮𝐣-𝐍𝐚𝐩𝐨𝐜𝐚.
𝐎𝐮𝐫 𝐭𝐞𝐜𝐡 𝐜𝐚𝐩𝐚𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐞𝐬 𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐚𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐛𝐮𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data Management, Touchpoint Channels & Integration, Core Banking, and Global Products.
We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged.
For us, impact isn't a perk. It's the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you?
We are seeking aSenior Data Engineerto design, build, and optimize data pipelines and platforms that enable advanced analytics and business intelligence. This role emphasizesETL development,data modeling,BI integration, and modern automation practices usingPythonandApache Airflow, with experience inAzure DevOpsand optional exposure toGoogle Cloud Platform (GCP).
ETL Development: Design, implement, and maintain ETL workflows using enterprise tools (IBM DataStage, Informatica, or similar).
Data Modeling: Develop and optimize data models for analytics and reporting, ensuring scalability and performance.
BI Enablement: Integrate and support BI tools, with a focus onPower BIandIBM Cognos, enabling self-service analytics.
Automation & Orchestration: Build Python scripts for data automation and orchestrate workflows usingApache Airflow.
Cloud & DevOps: UtilizeAzure DevOpsfor CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and version control.
Cloud Integration (Nice-to-Have): Familiarity withGCP services(BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Composer) for data processing and deployment.
Data Platform Strategy: Contribute to the evolution of next-generation data management platforms.
Quality & Governance: Ensure data quality, security, and compliance across all solutions.
Agile Delivery: Safeguard Agile-Scrum principles in team operations, promoting iterative delivery and continuous improvement.
What you’ll bring to the team
Proven experience in ETL development and data engineering.
Strong knowledge of data modeling for analytics and BI.
Hands-on experience with Python automation and Airflow orchestration.
Experience with BI tools (Power BI,IBM Cognos) and enabling self-service reporting.
Familiarity withAzure DevOpsfor CI/CD and deployment automation.
Understanding of Agile methodologies and experience in Scrum teams.
(Nice-to-have) Exposure toGCPand its data services.
ETL Tools: IBM DataStage, Informatica (or similar)
Languages: Python (automation and scripting)
Orchestration: Apache Airflow
BI Tools: Power BI, IBM Cognos
Cloud & DevOps: Azure DevOps
Databases: Oracle Exadata, SQL-based systems
Cloud (Nice-to-Have): Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Dataflow, Composer)
(Optional): Apache NiFi, Cloudera
